# Critic gate, round 1

24 October 2026. Five critics scored the first bold proposal (Lagoon, Strike, Orrery, Rally, Array). The panel did not converge. Nothing in that proposal was implemented.

Art direction blocked a free color editor, shared spinners, spotlight, beams, magnetic controls, and signal colors used as body text. UX blocked motion that moves labels or shrinks a hit target under 44px, and the missing first-frame actions (Book, Register, Start trial, Join, Call). Motion blocked Lagoon and Rally as the same soft pop, and missing per-component property lists for button, toast, and modal. Engineering blocked white text on Strike crimson (3.81:1) and any Lagoon blur or goo filter. The devil blocked the kit until each overlay has its own entrance.

Round 2 applies those fixes. Scores from round 1 stay in this file. Per-component files are written when a round clears 8 from all five.

## Art direction

Idea of five personalities: 8. Plan of one kit with shared transitions: 6. Free color and font editor: 3. Motion intensity: 6. Themes: Lagoon 6, Strike 7, Orrery 7, Rally 6, Array 5. Most controls 4–7. Spotlight 2. Beams 2. Magnetic 3.

## UX

Idea 7, plan 6, design 4, theme 3. Scroll progress 8. Almost every control under 8 because labels, 44px targets, and the resting state were unspecified.

## Motion

Strike, Orrery, and Array ideas at 8. Lagoon idea 7, Rally idea 7. Similarity: Lagoon–Rally. Component rows mostly 2 because the property list was missing. Toast enter scored 1 on four themes.

## Engineering

Body pairs pass AA. Strike button 6 until the label is `#090909` on a light fill, not white on `#ff1f3d`. Lagoon idea 6 until blur and goo filters are gone. Spotlight 5, beams 6, scramble 6, blob 6, parallax 6.

## Devil

BLOCK. Strike idea 9. Orrery idea 8. Array idea 8. Lagoon and Rally ideas 7. Forms 5, overlays 4, toast 3, modal 4.
